roleLabel: Taunt Tank — Come At Me! pulls focus, Stall-scaled Shields, then retaliates with Poison/Frost
bestFor: Stall / Debuff boards that want enemies glued to the tank instead of diving carries
strength: Forced targeting plus Shield dump damage; Retribution Poisons attackers after Stall
weakness: Needs Stall count and Defense; without them the taunt is a suicide button

howToPlay.early: Strong when you can buy Defense and live the taunt. Do not taunt naked into elites with zero Shields plan.
howToPlay.mid: Haughty/Come At Me path = taunt carry identity. Winter's Bite = Poison also applies Frost and Frost grants Shields. Bristleguard = team Tank start Poison + Defense. Pick selfish taunt, dual status, or Tank tribal.
howToPlay.late: Patience/Defense Tank relics and Stall engines. Keep Stall triggers high so Come At Me Shields scale.
howToPlay.positioning: Front-center where you want the pack to stand. Taunt fails its job if your carry is still the closest dive target geometrically — fix lanes.

abilityNotes.Come At Me!: Taunt → Stall-scaled Shields → damage from remaining Shields to anyone hitting him. Survive the half-second, then cash the Shield.

specNotes.The Haughty: Taunt / Retribution identity — default when Skorn is your main peel tank.
specNotes.The Winter's Bite: Poison↔Frost loop with Shield gain. Take on dual-status boards.
specNotes.The Bristleguard: Multi-Tank start Poison and team Defense. Take with other Tanks.

relicReasons.tanks-patience-banner-521: Stall/patience tools feed Come At Me Shield scaling.
relicReasons.tanks-intercession-prism-3002: Tank peel fantasy matching forced targeting.
relicReasons.defensive-amplifier-2016: Defense amp for Retribution Poison and survivability.

faq.question: Is Skorn good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Excellent peel tank when Stall/Defense are real. Bad if he taunts and dies instantly. Buy him to redirect damage, not to race DPS.

faq.question: What class is Skorn?
faq.answer: Tank. Role focus: taunt frontliner with Stall Shields and Poison retaliation.

faq.question: What relics work with Skorn?
faq.answer: Tank Patience/Intercession pieces, defensive amplifiers, and Stall enablers.

faq.question: How do you play Skorn?
faq.answer: Stack Defense and Stall, cast Come At Me when you can live it, and specialize toward Haughty, Winter's Bite, or Bristleguard tribal.

tips: If carries still die first, check dive pathing — taunt is not magic immunity for the backline.
Bristleguard wants multiple Tanks; solo Skorn usually prefers Haughty/Winter's Bite.
